findings.quote: VPN connections on one virtual private gateway share an aggregate throughput of [up to 1.25 Gbps](...), so more connections add no bandwidth.
findings.evidence: Fact site-to-site-vpn-faq-vgw-aggregate-throughput is scoped 'from AWS to on-premises': 'Multiple VPN connections to the same Virtual Private Gateway are bound by an aggregate throughput limit from AWS to on-premises of up to 1.25 Gbps.' (www/vpn/faqs). The q002 stem ('Nightly transfers') and the q009 stem ('carries the full load') give no direction, and in the story the data flows from the data center to AWS. findings.resolution: fix-12: see claims-12-05 and claims-12-06; both whys now rest on site-to-site-vpn-ecmp-not-on-vgw-supported-on-tgw.

findings.quote: A VPN backup avoids the location, but [performance over the internet is best effort], so it ranks below a second Direct Connect location.
